shared_elements: animals shown in profile in relief
low-relief carving on a flat surface
repeated row of similar forms along a band
justification: Both are low-relief surfaces organized into horizontal registers containing profile animals, and both include a row of repeated similar forms along an upper band. But A shows schematic, isolated animals (a large predator-like beast, a bird with long neck, a small bird, boar-like creature) with no human figures and no interaction, whereas B shows a crowded naturalistic narrative of human figures with weapons, a horse-drawn chariot with wheel, and a bull, all engaged in a coherent processional scene.
